category_title: Disruptive students who feel targeted and disrespected by authority figures
scenario_title: Explaining perspective during a disciplinary hearing
minimal_context: Kyle is explaining his side of the story regarding a classroom incident during a Youth Court hearing preparation.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Kyle, we need to go over your case. Please explain your side of the story about what happened in class.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I was just being loud because of what was going on. I made a remark, and the teacher warned me and put my name on the board.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Okay. And what about your relationship with the dean of discipline, Mrs. W?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I do not get along with her. She makes fun of me by calling me by my wrong last name.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's stay on track. People mispronounce names sometimes, so let's just focus on the facts.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: No, she is intentionally mispronouncing my last name to disrespect me! She has frequent contact with me and still says it wrong on purpose. You guys aren't even listening to my side!
